description: Remove the authenticated bot from a guild by server ID. The bot ceases to be a member immediately and requires a new invite URL with bot scopes to rejoin. Use this when the bot is instructed to depart a server; to kick another member use discord_delete_guild_member (members toolset). Returns deleted: true and the guild ID. No special bot permissions. Destructive: the user is asked to approve the exact change before it runs.

guild_id.description: ID of the guild to leave

name: discord_leave_guild
